player_prompt.intro:
Wɔde di Blackjack ka ho nsɛm wɔ dealer.
Wɔde adwene si sɛ wɔbɛnya nsɛm a ɛbɛyɛ 21 a ɛnyɛ hu.
Wɔ wo nsa no so, gyina hɔ ma '[Hit]' sɛ wopɛ draw nsa foforo anaa '[Stand]' sɛ wopɛ tena ahyɛ.
J/Q/K = 10 nsɛm; A = 11 anaa 1, sɛ ɛyɛ sen biara.
